body.x: HYPER(www.hypershop.com) introduced ‘iUSBportMini’ at '2014 International CES', the biggest IT∙appliances show held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.

iUSBport Mini is a wireless flash drive for iPhone, iPad, Android and the most compact version in the iUSBport family. it is instantly accessible to your iPhone, iPad, Android, Mac, PC or any WiFi device. No Internet required. iUSBport Mini has a built-in wireless router that creates its own wireless network to share USB/MicroSDXC data with nearby devices. Powered by a rechargeable lithium polymer battery lasts up to 3 hours.

'CES(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500 ~ 3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance. More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
